output.reason: [ev-e09c6cbd06dc] says the inbound retry policy is added (so on by default) and is only reverted by setting ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY to false. Any environment that has not set the variable to false is therefore exposed, including one that sets it explicitly to true. The proposed exposure "unset" is too narrow because it misses those environments. The correct exposure is not(equals false), and environments that set it to false are the shielded overlap.

correction.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds an inbound retry policy that automatically resets requests the service has not seen or processed. It applies to every environment that has not set ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY to false. Environments that set it to false keep the previous behaviour.
